1.web: Hear Yahweh’s word, you children of Israel; for Yahweh has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.
1.asv: Hear the word of Jehovah, ye children of Israel; for Jehovah hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.

2.web: There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed.
2.asv: There is nought but swearing and breaking faith, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery; they break out, and blood toucheth blood.

3.web: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells therein will waste away. all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky; yes, the fish of the sea also die.
3.asv: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field and the birds of the heavens; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.

4.web: “Yet let no man bring a charge, neither let any man accuse; For your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.
4.asv: Yet let no man strive, neither let any man reprove; for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.

5.web: You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother.
5.asv: And thou shalt stumble in the day, and the prophet also shall stumble with thee in the night; and I will destroy thy mother.

6.web: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you may be no priest to me. Because you have forgotten your God’s law, I will also forget your children.
6.asv: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I also will forget thy children.

7.web: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame.
7.asv: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me: I will change their glory into shame.

8.web: They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.
8.asv: They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.

9.web: It will be, like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will repay them for their deeds.
9.asv: And it shall be, like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will requite them their doings.

10.web: They will eat, and not have enough. They will play the prostitute, and will not increase; because they have abandoned giving to Yahweh.
10.asv: And they shall eat, and not have enough; they shall play the harlot, and shall not increase; because they have left off taking heed to Jehovah.

11.web: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
11.asv: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the understanding.

12.web: My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God.
12.asv: My people ask counsel at their stock, and their staff declareth unto them; for the spirit of whoredom hath caused them to err, and they have played the harlot, departing from under their God.

13.web: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks and poplars and terebinths, because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, and your brides commit adultery.
13.asv: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and terebinths, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters play the harlot, and your brides commit adultery.

14.web: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, nor your brides when they commit adultery; because the men consort with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes; so the people without understanding will come to ruin.
14.asv: I will not punish your daughters when they play the harlot, nor your brides when they commit adultery; for the men themselves go apart with harlots, and they sacrifice with the prostitutes; and the people that doth not understand shall be overthrown.

15.web: “Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don’t let Judah offend; and don’t come to Gilgal, neither go up to Beth Aven, nor swear, ‘As Yahweh lives.’
15.asv: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Beth-aven, nor swear, As Jehovah liveth.

16.web: For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will Yahweh feed them like a lamb in a meadow.
16.asv: For Israel hath behaved himself stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer: now will Jehovah feed them as a lamb in a large place.

17.web: Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!
17.asv: Ephraim is joined to idols; let him alone.

18.web: Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually. Her rulers dearly love their shameful way.
18.asv: Their drink is become sour; they play the harlot continually; her rulers dearly love shame.

19.web: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.
19.asv: The wind hath wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be put to shame because of their sacrifices.
